---
title: "Sentiment"
---

```{r}
#| label: sentiment-load
#| echo: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
if (!file.exists("data/processed/sentiment_by_chapter.csv")) {
  source("R/02_sentiment_analysis.R")
}
sentiment <- read_csv("data/processed/sentiment_by_chapter.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

This page rebuilds the sentiment analysis in a reproducible way rather than relying on old saved PNG files.

## Net sentiment by chapter

```{r}
#| echo: false
sentiment %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(chapter_title, chapter), y = net_bing_sentiment)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Positive words minus negative words", title = "Net Bing sentiment by chapter") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## AFINN score by chapter

```{r}
#| echo: false
sentiment %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(chapter_title, chapter), y = afinn_score)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "AFINN score", title = "AFINN sentiment by chapter") +
  theme_minimal()
```
